# awscc_supportauthz_support_permit (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SupportAuthZ::SupportPermit. Represents a support permit that grants AWS support time-bounded access to one or more resources for a set of actions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the support permit.
- `permit` (Attributes) The grant definition: which actions on which resources, optionally constrained by time conditions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permit))
- `signing_key_info` (Attributes) The signing key used by the permit. Exactly one key type must be provided. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--signing_key_info))

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the support permit.
- `support_case_display_id` (String) The support case display identifier associated with the permit. When provided, the permit is linked to the specified AWS Support case.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) A list of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the support permit.
- `created_at` (String) The time at which the support permit was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `permit_id` (String) The service-generated identifier of the support permit (the resource segment of the ARN).
- `status` (String) The current status of the support permit.

<a id="nestedatt--permit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permit`

Required:

- `actions` (Attributes) The set of actions a support permit grants. Exactly one of AllActions or Actions must be provided. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permit--actions))
- `resources` (Attributes) The set of resources a support permit applies to. Exactly one of AllResourcesInRegion or Resources must be provided. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permit--resources))

Optional:

- `conditions` (Attributes List) Optional time-bound conditions (at most two). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permit--conditions))

<a id="nestedatt--permit--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permit.actions`

Optional:

- `actions` (List of String) An explicit list of actions to grant.
- `all_actions` (String) Grants all actions.


<a id="nestedatt--permit--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permit.resources`

Optional:

- `all_resources_in_region` (String) Applies to all resources in the region.
- `resources` (List of String) An explicit list of resource ARNs.


<a id="nestedatt--permit--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permit.conditions`

Optional:

- `allow_after` (String) The permit is active only after this time.
- `allow_before` (String) The permit is active only before this time.



<a id="nestedatt--signing_key_info"></a>
### Nested Schema for `signing_key_info`

Required:

- `kms_key` (String) The ARN of the KMS key used to sign permit grants.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 256 Unicode characters in length.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_supportauthz_support_permit.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the support permit

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_supportauthz_support_permit.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_supportauthz_support_permit.example "arn"
```
